known_boundaries: Text rsd/modeling.py omits vision and cannot directly run screenshot CUA.
CUA-Lite 2B two-GPU examples do not validate 9B multimodal training on this project's two H100s.
CUA-Lite paper and inspected code use different filtered desktop evaluation counts.
CUA-Lite DAgger is online hard-target SFT; not interchangeable with full-distribution KL OPSD.
Failure repair, counterfactual localization, attack-defense co-evolution and CUA safe-continuation training all have prior work.
Safe task completion, attack failure, refusal and inability must remain distinct.
Task and attack-family test isolation must precede generating variants.
Selected repository inspection does not certify license compatibility, runtime compatibility or full paper reproduction.
CUA datasets, integrations, verifier calibration, exact sample contracts and capacity tests remain to be done.
